Identity and homelands

Karuk homelands center on the middle Klamath River in northwestern California. River relationships and environmental stewardship remain central.

02

Historical context

The Tribe’s land account explains the unratified California treaties, federal forest claims, and continuing recovery of ancestral lands.

Read the sources [1] Karuk Tribe

03

Living communities and further study

The Karuk People’s Center combines a museum, archives, language work, basketweaving, and public interpretation through Karuk perspectives.

Klamath and Salmon River War of 1855 and its aftermath · 14 links

A regional historical topic linked here for Karuk, Yurok, and Hupa context. The Klamath River is a place name here; this is not a study of the Klamath people of Oregon. Relevance must be assessed source by source.
